messages.raw: Come back with the right amount of items!
messages.text: Come back with the right amount of items!
messages.zh: 带够数量的物品再回来!

messages.text: Hey there!
messages.zh: 嘿!

messages.raw: §fI'm a world-famous artist to be. Most people just call me "the new da Vinci".
messages.text: I'm a world-famous artist to be. Most people just call me "the new da Vinci".
messages.zh: 我是未来的世界级艺术家。大家一般管我叫“新一代达芬奇”。

messages.raw: §fUnfortunately I ran out of dye this morning...
messages.text: Unfortunately I ran out of dye this morning...
messages.zh: 可惜今天早上我的颜料用完了……

messages.raw: §fIn my garden are some flowers. Could you pick §e5 Poppies§f and turn them into §eRose Red Dye§f, then bring them back to me?
messages.text: In my garden are some flowers. Could you pick 5 Poppies and turn them into Rose Red Dye, then bring them back to me?
messages.gloss: Poppy 用原版译名「虞美人」;Rose Red Dye → 玫瑰红染料,和 Common_Sidebar.json 的任务行一致。
messages.zh: 我的园子里种着些花。你能摘 5 朵虞美人,做成玫瑰红染料,再拿回来给我吗?

segments.text: In my garden are some flowers. Could you pick
segments.zh: 我的园子里种着些花。你能摘

segments.text: , then bring them back to me?

messages.text: Wow! That's the most beautiful red dye I have ever seen!
messages.zh: 哇! 这是我见过最美的红色染料!

messages.text: Take this Spray Can!
messages.gloss: Spray Can → 喷漆罐,和 Common_Sidebar.json「Talk to Marco about Spray Cans」的译法一致。
messages.zh: 这罐喷漆送你!

messages.text: You can select a spray by left-clicking your Spray Can!
messages.zh: 拿着喷漆罐左键,就能选择喷绘图案!

messages.text: Right-click any wall on your private island to spray it. If you ever lose your Spray Can, you can craft another one using the recipe in your Recipe Book!
messages.zh: 在私人岛屿上对着任意墙面右键就能喷上去。要是喷漆罐弄丢了,用配方书里的配方再做一罐就行!

messages.text: Thank you so much for your help. You should visit me in my Canvas Room sometime! Step into the portal to the left over there!
messages.zh: 太感谢你的帮忙了。有空来我的画布室坐坐! 走左边那扇传送门就到!

messages.text: Look who it is... you made it to my Canvas Room!
messages.zh: 瞧瞧这是谁……你还真找到我的画布室了!

messages.text: Since you're here already... would you like to draw something?
messages.zh: 既然来都来了……想不想画点什么?

messages.text: Put your Spray Can in your hand, hold right-click and move it across the canvas to draw!
messages.zh: 手里拿着喷漆罐,按住右键在画布上移动,就能画画!

messages.text: You can choose a color by clicking it in the palette below the canvas.
messages.zh: 点画布下方调色板里的颜色就能换色。

messages.text: Let me know when you're done with your painting!
messages.zh: 画完了告诉我一声!

messages.text: Wow! It's beautiful!
messages.zh: 哇! 太美了!

messages.text: For now, enjoy the sprays you have available in your Spray Can!
messages.zh: 眼下嘛,先好好玩玩你喷漆罐里已有的图案吧!

messages.text: Thank you again for your help!
messages.zh: 再次感谢你的帮忙!

messages.text: Before spraying on a wall, consider previewing it in the menu! Right-click on any spray of your choice and it'll magically appear in your hand.
messages.zh: 往墙上喷之前,不妨先在菜单里预览一下! 右键点任意一个图案,它就会神奇地出现在你手里。

messages.text: Don't forget to refill your spray can with dye! You can pick some of the flowers in my garden if you want to.
messages.zh: 别忘了给喷漆罐补充染料! 想要的话,可以去我园子里摘些花。

messages.text: You can select sprays by left-clicking with your Spray Can!
messages.zh: 拿着喷漆罐左键就能选择图案!

messages.text: I love sprays! So many colors!
messages.zh: 我太爱喷绘了! 五颜六色的!

messages.text: In the future, the canvas room will let you save your drawings to sprays!
messages.zh: 将来,画布室还能把你的画保存成喷绘图案!

messages.text: In the distant future I'll let you create your very own sprays with this canvas...
messages.zh: 再往后,我还打算让你用这块画布做出专属于自己的图案……
